paite: Huchi a Judah leh Benjamin melmate'n saltangte tate'n TOUPA, Israel' Pathian a ding in tempul alam uh chih azak un;
heading: Tempul Lam Thak Ding Dalna

paite: Zerubbabel leh pipute inko lupente kiang ah ahong pai nai ua, akiang uah, "Hon lampih le ung ake: noute bang in, na Pathian uh lah ka zong ngal ua; Assuria kumpipa Esarhaddon in hiai mun ahon pipa dam lai nite a kipan amah kiang ah ka kithoih uhi," achi uhi.

Himahleh Zerubbabel leh Jeshua leh Israel pipu inko lupente'n akiang uah, "Ka Pathian uh a dia inn na hon lampihna ding ziak bangmah na nei kei uh; himahleh Persia kumpipa Kura in kou thu ahon piak bang in, Israel' Pathian, TOUPA a ding in koute'n ka lam ding uhi," achi uhi.
Huchi in gam a mite'n Judah a mite khut ahatsakta kei ua, inn lamna ah amau asubuaita uhi.
Persia kumpipa Kura dam lai tengteng, Persia kumpipa Darias lal lai tanpha in, athiltup uh kalhse ding, amaute siatna ding in thuhilh mite aguai uhi.
Ahasueras vaihawm pat tung lai in, Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte hekna lai agelh uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Lam Thak Ding Dalna

paite: Huan Artaksarses dam lai in Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel leh akithuahpihte'n Persia kumpipa Artaksarses kiang ah lai agelh ua; laikhak gelhdan Siria laimal a gelh a, Siria pau a bawlkhiak ahi.
Sepaih heutu lian Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai in Jerusalem siatna ding in kumpipa Artaksarses kiang ah hichibang in laikhak agelh uhi.

Sepaih heutu lian Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh akithuahpihte un huchi in agelhta ua; Dinai mite, Apharsatki mite, Tarpe mite, Aphar mite, Arki mite, Babulon mite, Susan mite, Deha mite, Elam mite leh,
Osnappar lian leh thupi in apikhiak, Samaria khopi leh luipi khen a gamdang leh adangdang a kikoih namte tan in.
Kumpipa Artaksarses kiang a alaikhak uh teisawn hiai ahi: "Luipi khen lam leh adangdang a na sikhate.

Na kiang a kipan a hong tou Judate Jerusalem ah kou kiang ah ahong uh chih kumpipa kiang ah theih in om hen: Khopi helhat leh hoih lou alam lellel ua, akulhbaangte azouta ua, asuangphumte apuah khinta uh.
Kumpipa'n thei hen, hiai khopi lam a a-om a, akulhbaangte zoh in omleh zaw, leimante, siahte sumsinna leimante hiam lamlian leimante ape kei ding ua, atawptawp in kumpipa siatna ahi ding.
Tu in koute kumpi inn a pan huhna ngahte ka hih ziak un, kumpipa zahlakna muh koute ding in akilawm kei a, huaiziak in kumpipa thudik ka hon khak uhi.

Na pipute chiamtehna laibu sung ah kizong hen: huchi in chiamtehna laibu sung ah na mu ding a, hiai khopi helhat, kumpipate leh bialte a dia poikhoih hat chih leh nidanglai mah in leng huai sung mah a helna ana bawlta uh chih na thei mai ding; huaiziak a hiai khopi kihihsegawp lah ahi ngal a.
Hiai khopi akilam a, akulhbaangte hichibang a akihih khitleh zaw, luipi khen lam ah tan na nei kei ding chih kumpipa ka hon theitelsak uhi," chi in.
Huchi in dansiam Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh Samaria leh luipi khen a gam a teng akithuahpih tengteng kiang ah kumpipa'n dawnna akhak hi: Chibai,
"Laikhak ka kiang a na hon khak uh ka ma ah teltak a sim ahita.
Huchi in thu ka pia a, akizong khin a, nidanglai in hiai khopi in kumpipate tung ah helna abawl a, huai ah helpina leh helna a na kibawlta chih muhkhiak in a-om hi.
Huai lou in kumpipa thilhihthei taktak, luipi khen gam tengteng tung a vaihawm, Jerusalem tung a vaihawmte ana om ua; van leimante, sumsinna leimante leh lamlian leimante amau kiang a piak ahi hi.
Huchi in keimah in thupiak ka bawl masiah, huai mite khawl ding leh hiai khopi lam lou ding in, thupiak bawl un.
Hiai thu a ze-ol lou ding in pilvang un: Bang ding in kumpipate siatna ding in hoihlouhna akhang dia?" chi in.

Huchi a kumpipa Artaksarses laikhak teisawn Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh akithuahpihte ma a asim khit un, kintak in Jerusalem a Judate kiang ah ahoh ua, kihatsakna leh thilhihtheihna zang in amau akhawlsakta uhi.
Huchi in Jerusalem a Pathian inn nasep akhawl a: Persia kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum nihna tan in akhawl hi.
